title: `getRisksInCell` uses strict `===` equality — float or string `likelihood`/`impact` values silently misplace risks into wrong cell
description: `getRisksInCell` filters with `r.likelihood === cellLikelihood && r.impact === cellImpact` using strict `===`. If `likelihood` or `impact` are stored as floats (e.g., `2.5`) or strings (`"3"`), they never match any integer cell.
fixEvidence: Re-verified 2026-08-27: RiskHeatMap.jsx:89-94 now computes `Math.round(Number(risk.likelihood || risk.riskAssessment?.likelihood || 0))` before the `===` comparison. Confirmed fixed for the cited pattern (separately, see new record RR-050: this component isn't wired into the Risk Center's own dashboard at all, so this fix is currently only exercised via SCRC/vCISO dashboards).

title: Single `PermissionGate permission='risk.read'` wraps all risk-center routes — no sub-permission differentiation for write, delete, or accept actions
description: All risk-center routes are behind a single `PermissionGate permission='risk.read'`. No differentiated gates for write, delete, accept, or governance actions at the frontend layout level.
fixEvidence: Re-verified 2026-08-27 per this module's own Architecture note (do not rubber-stamp fixed just because the file moved): risk-center/layout.jsx:60 still reads exactly `<PermissionGate permission="risk.read" allowProjectGrant>{children}</PermissionGate>` wrapping every sub-route with a single gate. The underlying frontend gap is unchanged — only relocated from the deleted risk-register/layout.jsx. (Note: the BACKEND is correctly granular — risk-register.routes.ts and sibling route files enforce distinct risk.read/create/update/delete/approve preHandlers per route, independently confirmed 2026-08-27 — this record is specifically about the frontend gate having no equivalent differentiation.) Re-opened; was incorrectly marked fixed in a prior conversion.
firstDetected: 2026-08-27 (re-opened; originally logged against the pre-restructure file)

title: `Documentation` and `Policy Compliance` radar dimensions differ by ≤ 5 points always — completely correlated; redundant governance view
description: `Documentation = Math.min(100, approvalRate + 5)` — always within 5 points of Policy Compliance. The governance radar has two nearly-identical dimensions instead of two independent signals.
fixEvidence: Re-verified 2026-08-27: same fix as RR-010 — `documentation` in governance/page.jsx is now derived from `risksWithJustification`/`risksWithTreatmentPlan` ratios, independent of `policyApprovalRate`. Confirmed fixed.

title: Similar-risk deduplication warning is informational only — user can save without acknowledging; duplicate risks can be created
description: When a similar existing risk is detected, the deduplication warning is shown as informational text only. Users can dismiss or ignore it and save the duplicate without any friction or forced acknowledgement.
fixEvidence: Re-verified 2026-08-27: AIRiskDraftModal.jsx:681 disables the Save button via `isDisabled={similarRisks.length > 0 && !acknowledgedDuplicate}`, requiring an explicit 'acknowledge' click (line 513) before saving. Confirmed fixed.

title: Trends CSV/PDF export lacks metadata (time range, export timestamp, org name, active filters) — evidence package incomplete for audit
description: Trends CSV/PDF export contains data rows only — no metadata header with time range, export timestamp, org name, or active filter state. Evidence packages are incomplete without this context.
fixEvidence: Re-verified 2026-08-27: trends/page.jsx:323,343,360 now prepend/include organisation name, export timestamp (ISO), time range, and active filters (JSON) as metadata in both CSV and Excel/HTML exports. Confirmed fixed.

title: `promotedAt` set client-side — `promotedAt` field does not exist in this codebase; false positive
fixEvidence: Re-verified 2026-08-27, and the ORIGINAL REASONING was itself wrong even though the closure verdict was right: `promotedAt` DOES exist in the codebase — `moduleRiskDoc.promotedAt = now` in BaseIntegrationService.ts:350, and `promotedAt: now` in ModuleRiskService.ts:569 and :593, typed at types/index.ts:1318. It is set SERVER-SIDE (backend `now`), not client-side as the original title claimed. The record's closure (wont_fix / false positive) is still correct — there is no client-set-timestamp integrity issue — but the stated reason should read 'promotedAt exists and is properly server-set on promotion, contradicting the original false claim that the field did not exist at all', not 'field does not exist'.
